seoDescription: Solarus amenities: members spa, main gym, adults-only and family pools, sunset rooftop lounge, wine vault and private beach access on Galveston Beach.

header.title: Amenities to live mindfully
header.intro: Amenities designed for expression, substance and growth. Built to push your body, relax your mind, and make you present in the moments that truly matter — these are Solarus' exceptional amenities.
header.imageAlt: The pool deck overlooking the beach

items.name: 24/7 security monitoring
items.description: Around-the-clock monitoring and secure facilities, with private access to the beach.

items.name: In-house wine vault
items.description: Environmentally controlled private lockers with optimal temperatures. Complete with a sommelier table.

items.name: Reserved parking
items.description: Park in the same spot every time — never waste time finding a spot again.

items.name: Game room
items.description: A space perfect for kids and adults who want to engage their minds and have fun.

items.name: Grill and gathering areas
items.description: With plenty of seating, these areas were designed with large, intimate gatherings in mind.

items.name: Visitor suites
items.description: Reserved suites in the building for your guests, so they can stay close by during their visit.

items.name: Exclusive members spa
items.description: Additional amenities that center around mindfulness and bodily connection.

items.name: Dog park and putting green
items.description: Each in its own separated area — engaging and entertaining for humans and furry friends alike.

items.name: Meeting space
items.description: A reservable space for meetings that foster creativity and productivity.

items.name: Private EV charging stations
items.description: Ample parking with charging options for all of our savvy EV drivers.

items.name: Coffee lounge
items.description: A gourmet cup of espresso awaits, with ambient soft music. Lounge in a beautifully designed space while you work or browse.

items.name: Curated library
items.description: A snug sanctuary, perfect for settling in with a good book.

items.name: Sunset rooftop lounge
items.description: A rooftop lounge positioned for Galveston's sunsets over the Gulf.

items.name: Private rooftop terraces
items.description: Reserved terraces above it all — open sky, sea air and the shoreline below.
